title: Prove the complete restore-frame optimum of the six-skip words
body:
## Summary

PR3053 left frame reassignment as a possible source of further savings. This proves the complete restore-only optimum for both pinned PR3042 six-skip words retained by PR3054.

```diff
  fixed scalar operations/order, A/B prefix, entrances and endpoints
- restore-frame optimum unknown
+ 2,160,000 legal assignments per provider, none cheaper
+ exactly 32 ties; every ADD frame fixed, five independent SCALE retimings
```

Every assignment's local bill differs by `d(2H1-H2)`, `d=0,...,9`, which is nonnegative for every positive saving exponent. Nine independent components reduce the exhaustive proof to 542 local candidates. This is a scoped negative result, with no new κ or supplier admission.

[Proof, exact source exports, receipts, credit and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8892832224cffb73553cc921e4e3b1ae75d7b886/research/rank7-restore-frame-optimum/README.md). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18982948).

## Evidence

- **Before:** single-gate promotions found no saving but left simultaneous contractions and rotated subspaces unchecked.
  **After:** forward joins, backward meets and exact component enumeration cover the entire stated frame domain. A separate internal implementation agrees on every component, global multiplicity and five-scale classification.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and 11 behavioral groups pass, including genuinely improvable fixtures and rejection of wrong axes, source drift, nonmonotone frames and false invoices. Optimized execution passes; Python 3.12/3.14 receipts match byte for byte. Strict Ruff checks pass.
- All 13 committed package files match their tested bytes. Frozen source exports bind PR3054 `4773c3ea67b471415870e38411fae313ec44a675`; canonical main and priority revision 6 were refreshed before submission.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-restore-frame-optimum
```

Credit dcharb78/PR3042, Sagar Thakrar/PR3053, Jeremy Kothe, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Gareth Davidson/PR1995/2013, and the retained lineage documented in the package. PR3056's separate scalar contraction changes the tested word and is outside this frozen scope.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only a new research package and its opt-in replay are added. The result concerns a monotone common-frame relaxation. Joint A/B/restore optimization, changed scalar words, native realization, allocation and outer/theorem admission remain open or inherited. The selected frontier is unchanged. Hosted CI is separate from the recorded local checks.
